data.text: Now I have enough context. Let me create the new files and refactor.
Now edit archiver.ts to remove the moved code and re-export.
Now let me write the test file.

Task complete. Summary of what I did:

## Changes

**New `src/core/spec/apply-deltas.ts`** — moved `applyOpenSpecDeltas` and its private `resolveOpenSpecRoot` verbatim from the watcher so core (and the sync) can share the deterministic delta merge.

**`src/watcher/archiver.ts`** — now imports the function from core, calls it exactly as `await applyOpenSpecDeltas(projectRoot, specFolderPath, config);`, and re-exports it for existing callers.

**New `src/core/vcs/sync-specs.ts`** — the "Default branch sync" step 1 requirement check (reads `.run/base` and the default-branch tip via `Vcs.show`, parses with `parseCapabilitySpec`/`parseDelta`, diffs MODIFIED/REMOVED/rename-source requirement text) and the step 3 rebuild (default copy in place, `applyOpenSpecDeltas`, stage).

**New `src/core/vcs/sync-main.ts`** — `syncWithDefaultBranch(projectRoot, config, change)` following the requirement step by step: ancestry short-circuit, requirement check, uncommitted merge tolerating only delta-living-spec conflicts, living-spec rebuild, `runPrepare`, proposal verify via `runVerificationCommand(..., null)`, and the authored `osq: <id> sync <default branch>` commit. Every stop aborts the merge and rethrows the exact message.

**New `tests/vcs-sync.test.ts`** — real temporary repos with a linked worktree and archived change, covering all five "Default branch sync" scenarios plus failing `vcs.prepare`, a rejecting `pre-commit` hook, and the "One merge for archive and sync" source inspection. Each stop asserts HEAD unchanged and status empty.

Task verify: **56 pass / 0 fail**. Full `pnpm verify` (typecheck, build, entire suite, lint) passed.

Result written to `openspec/changes/107-osq-land/.run/results/2.md`.
